global.title: Can taking dead military satellites out of orbit become a business?
global.summary: The Space Development Agency is putting money behind a field of companies developing vehicles to rendezvous with satellites, capture them and move them out of orbit. The goal is to determine whether commercial industry can provide a service the Pentagon may eventually need on a regular basis.

global.title: Colorado Springs and Huntsville look beyond Space Command fight
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Colorado Springs and Huntsville spent years on opposite sides of a bitter fight over U.S. Space Command . Now, with the headquarters move to Alabama underway, business and civic leaders from both cities are trying to turn that rivalry into a partnership built around military space and missile defense.
